contract.structural_score_basis: Axis 5 = CONTRACT & ADMIN, both halves, authored 2026-09-07 on security_analyst's hand-walk (2/2 layers walked_by: hand, observed 2026-08-23). Both layers — contract-upgrade and asset-permission on ethereum — terminate at DSPause with timelock 2d, both impl_upgradeable. ⚠️ THE 2d DOES NOT COVER EVERYTHING: the UsdsJoin path on BOTH layers reads timelock: none. ⚠️ AND THE 2d IS NOTICE, NOT PROTECTION — measured on this same DSPause during the sUSDS walk: plot() and drop() share ONE DSAuth authority, so there is NO INDEPENDENT CANCELLER, and against a compromised proposer the cancel power belongs to the compromised party. MIN_DELAY() and MINIMUM_DELAY() BOTH REVERT and setDelay() executes through the pause proxy, so 2d is a CURRENT SETTING, not a demonstrated floor. A configured delay is not an enforced one. HELD AT 7.0 on our cohort rubric rather than leniency: what earns a dock is the ABSENCE OF A REACTION WINDOW, and USDS still gives a holder one where the docked cases — USDT, USDC, thBILL, all zero delay — give none. ⚠️ USDS IS THE CONTROL CASE that rubric is pinned to, so this row is load-bearing across every asset scored against it. Set EQUAL to sUSDS's 7.0, not above: a wrapper's contract surface is its own PLUS the underlying's, so sUSDS cannot outrank USDS here.
